content_sections.heading: MeitY Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. MeitY/2026/1 gives the full conditions for each post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MeitY notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details and Pay
content_sections.text: Category-wise vacancies: Electronics & Communication Engineering - UR 05, SC 02, ST 01, OBC-NCL 01, EWS 01 (1 post reserved for PwBD-VH); Computer Science & Information Technology - UR 06, SC 01, ST 01, OBC-NCL 01, EWS 01 (1 post each reserved for PwBD-HH and PwBD-MD). The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease at MeitY's discretion.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for MeitY Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: GATE paper: Valid GATE 2024/2025/2026 score in Electronics and Communication Engineering (EC) or Computer Science and Information Technology (CS). Educational qualification: (A) Master's degree in Physical Sciences (e.g. Electronics, Applied Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, VLSI Design, Semiconductor, Microelectronics, Embedded Systems), Mathematical Sciences (Mathematics and Computing) or Computational and Information Sciences (e.g. Computer Science, Computer Application, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Informatics, Information Security, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cryptography) from a recognised University or Institute; OR (B) Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (minimum four-year course) in Electronics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical and Electronics, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Semiconductor, Cyber Security, Microelectronics, Material Sciences or a related discipline. The qualification must be held on the closing date of online applications.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on the closing date of applications: UR/EWS - 30 years, OBC (Non-creamy layer) - 33 years, SC/ST - 35 years. Relaxation: up to 10 years for PwBD; up to 5 years for Central Government servants with 3 years' continuous service in the same or allied line; Ex-servicemen including Ex SSCOs/ECOs as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Valid GATE Score. Pay: Level 10 of Pay Matrix. Qualification required: Valid GATE Score. Pay: Level 10 of Pay Matrix.

content_sections.heading: How Will MeitY Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Valid Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) Score (2024/2025/2026) Personal Interview Based on valid Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) Score (2024/2025/2026) and Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MeitY Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Get the application form: www.meity.gov.in. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Apply only through MeitY's online recruitment portal, which is to be launched shortly; no other mode of application will be accepted.
